title: Premium Billing Accounts: Reinstatement Terms Table
content:
Reinstatement of a lapsed Premium Billing Accounts arrangement is available on the terms in this table.

| Arrangement | Reinstatement window (calendar days) | Reinstatements allowed per rolling 12 months | Full past-due premium required | Reinstatement payment methods |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | 30 | 1 | yes | card, EFT |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 30 | 1 | yes | card, EFT |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | 30 | 1 | yes | card, EFT |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | 30 | 1 | yes | card, EFT |
| Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | 0 | 0 | yes | card, EFT |
| Cascade Group List Bill | 30 | 2 | yes | employer remittance |
| Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | 30 | 2 | yes | employer remittance |

**Column meanings**
- *Reinstatement window* — calendar days after the lapse (termination) date within which the account may be reinstated; 0 means no reinstatement.
- *Reinstatements allowed* — count of reinstatements allowed in any rolling 12 months; 0 means none.
- *Full past-due premium required* — when yes, all premium past due through the current month must be paid before reinstatement.
- *Reinstatement payment methods* — list of payment methods accepted for a reinstatement payment (certified funds rule).

**Points of judgement drawn from the table.** A Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly account has a window of 0 days and an allowance of 0, so it cannot be reinstated. The individual-market arrangements allow 1 reinstatement in any rolling 12 months and the group arrangements 2. Every arrangement requires all premium past due through the current month, and only card or EFT (individual and exchange) or employer remittance (group) is accepted for the reinstatement payment.
